rationale: The workflow already implements the workflow_yaml-scoped optimizations that fit it: concurrency with cancel-in-progress for the same ref (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, cancel superseded runs) and timeout-minutes: 60 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, bounded job). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is no matrix of jobs. The schedule-based patterns do not apply because there is no schedule trigger. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE does not apply because the workflow runs in a pre-built development container image (ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:development-${{ github.sha }}) and contains no dependency-installation step (no bundle install / npm install) whose downloads could be cached; the repository lockfiles exist but are not fetched in this workflow. No Bazel build exists, so the Bazel patterns do not apply. The remaining patterns are ci_service/build_configuration/research_only scope or require separately approved repository policy (P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS, P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR), and their preconditions are not verified here. Making any change would risk weakening intended build/test coverage or adding unsupported behavior, so no supported optimization is applicable.
